items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: In Toots Johnson's band, a guy named Boosta(?) used to have one

ctx.x: Let me ask you this. In any of these early bands that you saw, Toots Johnson, the Banner Band, Martel, did anybody in the band sing, or...
Oh, yes! The drummer more or less... In Toots Johnson's band, a guy named Boosta(?) used to have one

of those megaphones. He would sing. And Tody Harris, that band... And Tody didn't play nothing. He didn't even play a note! But he was still out in front of that band. And he had his megaphone. He sang. And I think Gustan... Gustan played a trombone. And I think all them bands had these megaphones.
